# Octax Racing Fuels

> Octax Racing Fuels supplies high-octane race fuels, methanol, ethanol and performance additives for motorsport, karting and marine, with online ordering and delivery.

This is a demonstration e-commerce site. Products, prices and stock are sample data
and no real orders are placed.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://echoforgesoftware.github.io/octax-racing-fuels-demo/): Overview of Octax Racing Fuels and featured products.
- [Shop](https://echoforgesoftware.github.io/octax-racing-fuels-demo/shop/): Full catalogue of race fuels, methanol, ethanol and additives.
- [Information](https://echoforgesoftware.github.io/octax-racing-fuels-demo/information/): Fuel selection guide, safe handling and delivery.
- [Contact](https://echoforgesoftware.github.io/octax-racing-fuels-demo/contact/): Enquiries about fuel advice, orders and delivery.

## Product categories
- [Race fuels](https://echoforgesoftware.github.io/octax-racing-fuels-demo/shop/?category=race-fuels): 102 to 118 octane leaded and unleaded competition fuels.
- [Methanol](https://echoforgesoftware.github.io/octax-racing-fuels-demo/shop/?category=methanol): High-purity methanol for methanol-burning engines.
- [Ethanol](https://echoforgesoftware.github.io/octax-racing-fuels-demo/shop/?category=ethanol): Anhydrous ethanol and consistent E85 blends.
- [Additives](https://echoforgesoftware.github.io/octax-racing-fuels-demo/shop/?category=additives): Octane boosters, lubricants and fuel-system treatments.
